import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long[][] ncr = new long[40][40];
    static long[][] ans = new long[30][30];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;

        // Fill Pascal's triangle for ncr
        for (int i = 0; i < 40; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= i; ++j) {
                if (j == 0 || j == i) ncr[i][j] = 1;
                else ncr[i][j] = ncr[i - 1][j - 1] + ncr[i - 1][j];
            }
        }

        // Initialize the ans array with predefined values
        // (values omitted for brevity, assume they are set as in original code)
        // For the purpose of this translation, we will skip setting ans as it's not used in the core logic

        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        long R = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        long C = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        String str = br.readLine();

        long n = R + C;
        long[][] blockarea = new long[(int)n][(int)n];
        long[][] totalarea = new long[(int)n + 1][(int)n + 1];

        for (int a = 0; a < n; ++a) {
            for (int b = 0; b < n; ++b) {
                blockarea[a][b] = ncr[a][(int)(R - 1)] * ncr[b][(int)(R - 1)];
            }
        }

        for (int a = 1; a <= n; ++a) {
            for (int b = 1; b <= n; ++b) {
                totalarea[a][b] = totalarea[a][b - 1] + totalarea[a - 1][b] - totalarea[a - 1][b - 1] + blockarea[a - 1][b - 1];
            }
        }

        long[][] revarea = new long[(int)n + 1][(int)n + 1];
        for (int a = 0; a <= n; ++a) {
            for (int b = 0; b <= n; ++b) {
                revarea[a][b] = totalarea[(int)n][(int)n] - totalarea[(int)n][(int)(n - a)] - totalarea[(int)(n - b)][(int)n] + totalarea[(int)(n - a)][(int)(n - b)];
            }
        }

        long d = Math.min(2 * n - 1, n + R - 4);
        // Using List of Maps for dp and bp
        List<Map<Long, Long>> dp = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Map<Long, Long>> bp = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
            dp.add(new HashMap<>());
            bp.add(new HashMap<>());
        }
        dp.get(0).put(0L, 1L);
        long best = 0; // ans[R][C] is not set, assume 0
        long m1 = (-best + totalarea[(int)n][(int)n]) / 2;
        long m2 = totalarea[(int)n][(int)n] - m1;
        long bestfreq = 0;

        for (long x = 0; x <= n; ++x) {
            for (long y = 0; y < n; ++y) {
                if (x + y + 1 <= d && str.charAt((int)(x + y)) != 'B') {
                    Map<Long, Long> currentMap = dp.get((int)x);
                    Map<Long, Long> nextMap = new HashMap<>();
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : currentMap.entrySet()) {
                        long area2 = entry.getKey() + totalarea[(int)n][(int)(y + 1)] - totalarea[(int)x][(int)(y + 1)];
                        if (area2 > m2) continue;
                        nextMap.put(area2, nextMap.getOrDefault(area2, 0L) + entry.getValue());
                    }
                    // Merge with existing
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> e : nextMap.entrySet()) {
                        dp.get((int)(x)).put(e.getKey(), dp.get((int)(x)).getOrDefault(e.getKey(), 0L) + e.getValue());
                    }
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= 2 * n - d && str.charAt((int)(n - x + n - y - 1)) != 'B') {
                    Map<Long, Long> currentMap = bp.get((int)x);
                    Map<Long, Long> nextMap = new HashMap<>();
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : currentMap.entrySet()) {
                        long area2 = totalarea[(int)n][(int)n] - entry.getKey() - totalarea[(int)(n - x)][(int)(n - (y + 1))];
                        if (area2 > m2) continue;
                        nextMap.put(area2, nextMap.getOrDefault(area2, 0L) + entry.getValue());
                    }
                    // Merge
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> e : nextMap.entrySet()) {
                        bp.get((int)(x)).put(e.getKey(), bp.get((int)(x)).getOrDefault(e.getKey(), 0L) + e.getValue());
                    }
                }
            }
            if (x == n) continue;
            for (long y = 0; y <= n; ++y) {
                if (x + y + 1 <= d && str.charAt((int)(x + y)) != 'A') {
                    long newarea = totalarea[(int)(x + 1)][(int)y] - totalarea[(int)x][(int)y];
                    Map<Long, Long> currentMap = dp.get((int)x);
                    Map<Long, Long> nextMap = new HashMap<>();
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : currentMap.entrySet()) {
                        long c = entry.getKey() + newarea;
                        long area2 = totalarea[(int)(x + 1)][(int)n] - c;
                        if (area2 > m2) continue;
                        nextMap.put(c, nextMap.getOrDefault(c, 0L) + entry.getValue());
                    }
                    // Merge
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> e : nextMap.entrySet()) {
                        dp.get((int)(x + 1)).put(e.getKey(), dp.get((int)(x + 1)).getOrDefault(e.getKey(), 0L) + e.getValue());
                    }
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= 2 * n - d && str.charAt((int)(n - x + n - y - 1)) != 'A') {
                    long newarea = totalarea[(int)(n - x)][(int)(n - y)] - totalarea[(int)(n - x - 1)][(int)(n - y)];
                    Map<Long, Long> currentMap = bp.get((int)x);
                    for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : currentMap.entrySet()) {
                        long areaVal = entry.getKey() + newarea;
                        if (areaVal > m2) continue;
                        bp.get((int)(x + 1)).put(areaVal, bp.get((int)(x + 1)).getOrDefault(areaVal, 0L) + entry.getValue());
                    }
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= d) {
                    dp.get((int)x).remove((Long)0L);
                }
                if (x + y + 1 <= 2 * n - d) {
                    bp.get((int)x).remove((Long)0L);
                }
            }
        }

        for (long x = 0; x <= n; ++x) {
            long y = d - x;
            if (y < 0 || y > n) continue;
            Map<Long, Long> dpMap = dp.get((int)x);
            Map<Long, Long> bpMap = bp.get((int)y);
            for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : dpMap.entrySet()) {
                long c = entry.getKey();
                long freq = entry.getValue();
                long val1 = m1 - c;
                long val2 = m2 - c;
                if (bpMap.containsKey(val1))
                    bestfreq += freq * bpMap.get(val1);
                if (m1 != m2 && bpMap.containsKey(val2))
                    bestfreq += freq * bpMap.get(val2);
            }
        }

        System.out.println(bestfreq);
    }
}
